decision_rule.warp_direction_pass: truth MIND and intensity are both <= ratio limit versus inverse_truth and zero in both regions
decision_rule.mind_slip_identifiable: truth MIND is <= ratio limit versus glued_mean_velocity in both regions
decision_rule.intensity_slip_identifiable: truth intensity is <= ratio limit versus glued_mean_velocity in both regions
decision_rule.optimizer_reduced_data_term: estimated_balanced MIND is <= ratio limit versus zero in both regions
decision_rule.descriptor_failure: intensity slip is identifiable but MIND slip is not
decision_rule.optimizer_or_parameterization_failure: MIND slip is identifiable but estimated field remains near-glued

challenge_policy.reason: screen uses development images and committed development fields only
